name: smwgraphics-sonic-cd-wacky-workbench-good-future
title: Sonic CD - Wacky Workbench (Good Future)
description:
You'd think I'd ripped this BG using LM Bitmap Pasting feature. Well... no. I had to do this manually as the palette given by the tool didn't satisfy me. Now it's easy to edit.
This is ripped from act 1. Acts 2 and 3 are irrelevant since those are the same graphics I'm uploading.
The small light is animated.
There are 6 sample levels total for this BG.
Since the BG was too big, I decided to paste the parts into 2 sample levels each.
Say you want to see 1 BG part and then the other. Check for example SCDWWGFsample1a.mwl and SCDWWGFsample1b.mwl. Those have the required parts. It's the same for the other 4 sample level. It might have its uses besides bonus.

No credit needed.

Edit: Both horizontal and vertical scrolling must be set to Medium.
